**Night mode for unsupported apps and websites!**

Night mode for apps and websites that do not have a dark theme. Nig follows the system appearance: when iOS is in Dark mode it recolours UIKit apps and the web pages shown in Safari, in-app browsers and web views. In Light mode it does nothing.

Dark colours become a lighter shade of the same hue, photos and QR codes are left alone.

Exclude a single app with Choicy, or a website in the Nig settings pane (Settings ▸ Nig ▸ Excluded sites).

Nig cannot recolour apps that draw their own UI (Flutter, games, some cross-platform apps) and it does not work in every app: some will look wrong or be left unchanged. Turn Nig off for that app or site if that happens.

Packages for rootless (iphoneos-arm64) and roothide (iphoneos-arm64e) jailbreaks. Requires iOS 14.0 or later, MobileSubstrate and PreferenceLoader.
- Requires iOS 14.0 or later instead of 16.0.
